```plato

// The eight vertex indices of one hexahedron
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hexahedron). A, B, C, D form the bottom quad
// wound counter-clockwise when viewed from outside (below); E, F, G, H are the
// corresponding vertices of the top quad (E above A, and so on).
type HexahedronCell
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    A: VertexIndex;
    B: VertexIndex;
    C: VertexIndex;
    D: VertexIndex;
    E: VertexIndex;
    F: VertexIndex;
    G: VertexIndex;
    H: VertexIndex;
}
```
